newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France makes pay offer to unions.
newsitem.headline: Air France makes pay offer to unions.

text.p: Air France, whose Air France Europe unit was hit by strikes on several occasions last year, said on Thursday it was offering unions a deal under which wages should rise by around 3.5 percent in 1997 and 1998 overall.
The offer was being made after a four-year wage freeze, it said in a statement.
Air France also said it aimed to achieve a global advance in salaries of 2.5 percent annually in the medium term.

It said that in 1997 and 1998, the period of the pay accord proposal, salaries should rise globally by 3.5 percent, once the adjustment of salary structures, general pay rises, promotions and other premiums were taken into account.
A spokeswoman said the Force Ouvriere trade union, one of the main trade unions within the group, had signed the accord.
